entities.summary: Omolabake Adenle is a Nigerian-American engineer, entrepreneur and financial strategist. She is the founder and chief executive officer (CEO) of AJA.LA Studios, a company that provides digital solutions to natural African languages. Adenle invented the application software "SpeakYoruba App" which won her an award on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in Voice by the Women In Voice (WiN) 2021 and was shortlisted for the African Innovation Foundation's Innovation Prize for Africa (IPA) awards 2017. Omolabake Adenle holds a Ph.D. in engineering from University of Cambridge, UK.
